description: Storage and derivation contract for packet-sequence models; it is not part of the 54-value MVP feature vector.

sequence_policy.ordering: capture order within one flow generation
sequence_policy.direction: forward source is established by the first packet of the flow generation

storage_policy.raw_frame_persistence: retain an immutable source-capture reference or an immutable byte copy

record_fields.name: capture_id
record_fields.semantics: stable identifier of the immutable PCAPNG or bounded DPDK capture

record_fields.name: packet_index
record_fields.semantics: zero-based packet position in the source capture

record_fields.name: flow_generation_id
record_fields.semantics: identifies one tuple generation without becoming model input

record_fields.name: flow_packet_ordinal
record_fields.semantics: one-based packet position in capture order within the flow generation

record_fields.name: direction
record_fields.semantics: direction relative to the first packet of this flow generation

record_fields.name: timestamp_ns
record_fields.semantics: exact source timestamp retained for audit and deterministic delta derivation

record_fields.name: delta_time_ns
record_fields.semantics: signed delta from the preceding packet in this flow generation; zero for the first packet

record_fields.name: clock_domain
record_fields.semantics: must remain constant within one flow stream

record_fields.name: captured_length
record_fields.semantics: number of bytes available in raw_frame

record_fields.name: wire_length
record_fields.semantics: reported frame length on the wire

record_fields.name: transport_protocol
record_fields.semantics: auxiliary protocol selector; excluded from the current flow model vector

record_fields.name: raw_frame
record_fields.semantics: complete captured frame bytes including headers and payload; persisted by reference or immutable copy

record_fields.name: vlan_header_range
record_fields.semantics: optional VLAN header location in raw_frame

record_fields.name: transport_header_range
record_fields.semantics: complete TCP or UDP header including TCP options

record_fields.name: payload_range
record_fields.semantics: transport payload location; zero length is valid

never_direct_model_inputs: raw TCP or UDP port bytes

guaranteed_inputs: up to the first 9 raw frames

future_adapter_contract.delta_time_normalization: fit on training partition only and persist with the model artifact
future_adapter_contract.paper_reproduction_sorting: offline experiment only; shared runtime semantics remain capture order
